title: Refactor product service helpers
body:
## Summary

Extracts a findById helper and renames a local variable. No behavior change intended.

## Changes

* findById helper
* rename local variable in list

## How to test

Run the existing tests.

verixa_should_cover: No behavior change, regression run only
Verixa should label it low risk and suggest a small regression set
A good Analysis Agent output says tests exist and nothing new is needed
